title: WikiLeaks video: 'Collateral murder' in Iraq
summary: Al Jazeera's full unedited version of the WikiLeaks 'Collateral Murder' footage from a US military helicopter cockpit, showing a 2007 Baghdad attack that killed about a dozen people, including two Reuters journalists.
why: HN cites it as primary evidence of US conduct in Iraq and as the leak most associated with Julian Assange's prosecution.

quote.text: What does happen is that a van stops to help and they blast it and the kids inside.
